esabcc-o1-ghg-total.name: Total EU GHG emissions (European Climate Law scope)
esabcc-o1-ghg-total.description: ESABCC progress indicator O1. Total EU-27 GHG emissions in the scope of the European Climate Law (EU-27 plus international aviation and maritime). 2030 target: -55% vs 1990; 2050: climate neutrality; ESABCC 2040 advice range: -90 to -95%.

esabcc-o2-pec.name: Primary energy consumption (EU-27)
esabcc-o2-pec.description: ESABCC progress indicator O2 (primary energy component). EED 2030 indicative benchmark applies; Climate Target Plan MIX 2050 trajectory used as longer-run benchmark.

esabcc-o2-fec.name: Final energy consumption (EU-27)
esabcc-o2-fec.description: ESABCC progress indicator O2 (final energy component). 2030 EED indicative benchmark: 763 Mtoe (~8 875 TWh).

esabcc-o3-gross-inland.name: Gross inland energy consumption (EU-27)
esabcc-o3-gross-inland.description: ESABCC progress indicator O3. Gross inland energy consumption covering all fuels and renewables. Benchmark from Climate Target Plan MIX 2050 scenario.

esabcc-e1-energy-supply-ghg.name: Energy supply GHG emissions
esabcc-e1-energy-supply-ghg.description: ESABCC progress indicator E1. Total energy supply emissions: public power & heat, refineries and other energy industries. Fit-for-55 MIX gives the 2030 benchmark.

esabcc-e2-fossil-power-share.name: Fossil share of EU electricity mix
esabcc-e2-fossil-power-share.description: ESABCC progress indicator E2 (fossil component). Share of fossil fuels in total electricity generation; complements the renewable share to highlight the substitution pace.

esabcc-e2-res-noBio-power-share.name: Non-biomass renewable share of EU electricity mix
esabcc-e2-res-noBio-power-share.description: ESABCC progress indicator E2 (renewables component). Share of non-biomass renewables (wind, solar PV, hydro, geothermal) in total electricity generation.

esabcc-e3-grid-co2-intensity.name: Average GHG intensity of EU electricity
esabcc-e3-grid-co2-intensity.description: ESABCC progress indicator E3. Average EU electricity GHG intensity (Scope-2). Fit-for-55 MIX 2030 benchmark plus 1.5TECH 2050 trajectory.

esabcc-e4a-solar-pv-add.name: Annual solar PV capacity additions (EU)
esabcc-e4a-solar-pv-add.description: ESABCC progress indicator E4a. Net new solar photovoltaic capacity commissioned per year across the EU-27.

esabcc-e4b-wind-add.name: Annual wind capacity additions (EU)
esabcc-e4b-wind-add.description: ESABCC progress indicators E4b (onshore) and E4c (offshore). Net new wind capacity commissioned per year, all axes.

esabcc-e5-electrification.name: Electrification rate of final energy use
esabcc-e5-electrification.description: ESABCC progress indicator E5. Share of electricity in total final energy consumption; Fit-for-55 MIX gives the 2030 benchmark.

esabcc-e6-energy-ch4.name: Energy-related methane emissions (EU-27)
esabcc-e6-energy-ch4.description: ESABCC progress indicator E6. Methane emissions from fuel combustion and fugitives. Aligned with the Methane Regulation.

esabcc-i1-industry-ghg.name: Industrial GHG emissions
esabcc-i1-industry-ghg.description: ESABCC progress indicator I1. Industrial CO₂ plus other GHGs (combustion + process emissions). Fit-for-55 MIX 2030 benchmark.

esabcc-i3-circular-mat-use.name: Circular material use rate (EU)
esabcc-i3-circular-mat-use.description: ESABCC progress indicator I3. Share of material input from recycled sources. Circular Economy Action Plan benchmark: 23.4% by 2030.

esabcc-i4-steel-ghg-intensity.name: GHG intensity of EU steel production
esabcc-i4-steel-ghg-intensity.description: ESABCC progress indicator I4 (steel component). Total emissions (combustion + process) per tonne of crude steel produced.

esabcc-i4-cement-ghg-intensity.name: GHG intensity of EU cement production
esabcc-i4-cement-ghg-intensity.description: ESABCC progress indicator I4 (cement component). Total emissions per tonne of cement produced.

esabcc-i4-chemicals-ghg-intensity.name: GHG intensity of EU base organic chemicals
esabcc-i4-chemicals-ghg-intensity.description: ESABCC progress indicator I4 (chemicals component). Combustion + process emissions per tonne of ethylene, propylene, methanol etc.

esabcc-i5-industry-fec.name: Industrial final energy consumption (EU)
esabcc-i5-industry-fec.description: ESABCC progress indicator I5. Final energy use in manufacturing industries (excluding non-energy use).

esabcc-i6-industry-electrification.name: Electricity share of industrial final energy use
esabcc-i6-industry-electrification.description: ESABCC progress indicator I6. Share of electricity in industrial final energy use (excluding non-energy use). Climate Target Plan benchmarks for 2030 and 2050.

esabcc-t1-transport-ghg.name: Transport GHG emissions (EU)
esabcc-t1-transport-ghg.description: ESABCC progress indicator T1. All EU-27 transport GHG emissions (road, rail, IWW, aviation). Fit-for-55 MIX 2030 benchmark.

esabcc-t2a-passenger-demand.name: Total passenger transport demand
esabcc-t2a-passenger-demand.description: ESABCC progress indicator T2a. Total passenger-kilometres travelled across all inland and air modes.

esabcc-t2b-freight-demand.name: Total freight transport demand
esabcc-t2b-freight-demand.description: ESABCC progress indicator T2b. Total freight tonne-kilometres across road, rail and inland waterways.

esabcc-t3a-road-share-passenger.name: Road share of motorised inland passenger transport
esabcc-t3a-road-share-passenger.description: ESABCC progress indicator T3a. Passenger-side road share (cars + two-wheelers) of motorised inland transport, excluding aviation, maritime and active modes.

esabcc-t3b-air-passenger.name: Intra-EU air passenger transport
esabcc-t3b-air-passenger.description: ESABCC progress indicator T3b. Intra-EU passenger-kilometres travelled by air; Fit-for-55 MIX 2030 plus 1.5LIFE/TECH 2050 benchmarks.

esabcc-t4-car-co2-intensity.name: Average CO₂ intensity of new passenger cars (WLTP)
esabcc-t4-car-co2-intensity.description: ESABCC progress indicator T4. Average tailpipe CO₂ intensity of newly registered cars, WLTP basis. Reg (EU) 2023/851 sets 0 g/km from 2035.

esabcc-t5a-zev-share-newcars.name: ZEV share of new passenger car registrations
esabcc-t5a-zev-share-newcars.description: ESABCC progress indicator T5a. Battery-electric + fuel-cell share of new passenger car registrations.

esabcc-t5b-zev-lorries-stock.name: Zero-emission lorries in the EU fleet
esabcc-t5b-zev-lorries-stock.description: ESABCC progress indicator T5b. Stock of zero-emission heavy-duty lorries on EU roads.

esabcc-t6a-fossil-transport-share.name: Fossil share of transport energy use
esabcc-t6a-fossil-transport-share.description: ESABCC progress indicator T6a. Fossil share of transport energy use including international bunker fuels.

esabcc-t6b-foodcrop-biofuels.name: Use of first-generation (food-crop) biofuels in transport
esabcc-t6b-foodcrop-biofuels.description: ESABCC progress indicator T6b. Energy from first-generation biofuels (food/feed crops) used in the transport sector.

esabcc-b1-buildings-ghg.name: Residential + tertiary building GHG emissions
esabcc-b1-buildings-ghg.description: ESABCC progress indicator B1. Direct GHG emissions from heating, cooling and cooking in residential and tertiary buildings.

esabcc-b2-buildings-fec.name: Final energy consumption in buildings
esabcc-b2-buildings-fec.description: ESABCC progress indicator B2. Final energy consumption in residential plus tertiary buildings (heating, cooling, appliances, lighting).

esabcc-b5a-residential-fossil-share.name: Fossil share of residential energy mix
esabcc-b5a-residential-fossil-share.description: ESABCC progress indicator B5a (fossil component). Share of fossil fuels in residential final energy consumption.

esabcc-b5b-tertiary-fossil-share.name: Fossil share of tertiary energy mix
esabcc-b5b-tertiary-fossil-share.description: ESABCC progress indicator B5b (fossil component). Share of fossil fuels in tertiary sector final energy consumption.

esabcc-b6-heat-pump-stock.name: EU stock of installed heat pumps
esabcc-b6-heat-pump-stock.description: ESABCC progress indicator B6. Cumulative stock of heat pumps. REPowerEU 2030 objective requires 60 million units.

esabcc-a1-agri-nonco2.name: Agricultural non-CO₂ emissions
esabcc-a1-agri-nonco2.description: ESABCC progress indicator A1. Non-CO₂ emissions from EU agriculture (enteric fermentation, manure, fertiliser, other).

esabcc-a3-fertiliser-use.name: Total fertiliser nitrogen use (EU)
esabcc-a3-fertiliser-use.description: ESABCC progress indicator A3 (total use). Total nitrogen applied as inorganic + organic fertiliser. Farm-to-Fork 2030 benchmark: 20% reduction vs 2018.

esabcc-a3-nue.name: Nitrogen use efficiency in EU agriculture
esabcc-a3-nue.description: ESABCC progress indicator A3 (efficiency component). Share of applied N that ends up in harvested products.

esabcc-a7-bioenergy-feedstock.name: Agricultural products used as bioenergy feedstock
esabcc-a7-bioenergy-feedstock.description: ESABCC progress indicator A7. Cereal and oilseed crops diverted to bioenergy. Climate Target Plan 2030 benchmark for sustainable levels.

esabcc-l1-lulucf-net.name: LULUCF net GHG balance
esabcc-l1-lulucf-net.description: ESABCC progress indicator L1. Net GHG balance for land use, land-use change and forestry (negative = net removals). LULUCF Regulation 2030 target: net -310 Mt CO₂eq.

esabcc-l3-afforestation.name: Annual afforested area
esabcc-l3-afforestation.description: ESABCC progress indicator L3. Annual area of land newly classified as forest (afforestation).

esabcc-l4-deforestation.name: Annual deforested area
esabcc-l4-deforestation.description: ESABCC progress indicator L4. Annual area of forest converted to other land uses (deforestation).

esabcc-l5-settlement-area.name: Annual settlement area increase (net land take proxy)
esabcc-l5-settlement-area.description: ESABCC progress indicator L5. Annual increase in settlement area used as proxy for net land take. 7th EAP no-net-land-take 2050 target.

esabcc-l6-forest-sink.name: Forest land living-biomass carbon sink
esabcc-l6-forest-sink.description: ESABCC progress indicator L6. Net removals attributed to living forest biomass (negative = removals).

esabcc-l7-nonforest-lulucf.name: Non-forest LULUCF net GHG emissions
esabcc-l7-nonforest-lulucf.description: ESABCC progress indicator L7. Net GHG balance from cropland, grassland, wetlands and settlements (positive = net emissions).

esabcc-l8-bioenergy-use.name: Total bioenergy use (EU-27)
esabcc-l8-bioenergy-use.description: ESABCC progress indicator L8. Final consumption of bioenergy across power, heat, transport, industry and other sectors.

esabcc-f-fossil-subsidies.name: EU fossil-fuel subsidies (FFST)
esabcc-f-fossil-subsidies.description: ESABCC chapter on finance. Total EU fossil-fuel subsidies estimated by the Fossil Fuel Subsidy Tracker. Should fall to zero per Council conclusions.

esabcc-f-green-bonds.name: EU green bond issuance
esabcc-f-green-bonds.description: ESABCC chapter on finance. Annual green bond issuance by EU issuers (sovereign + corporate).

esabcc-f-green-bonds-share.name: Green share of EU bond issuance
esabcc-f-green-bonds-share.description: ESABCC chapter on finance. Green bonds as a share of total EU bond issuance.

esabcc-f-gerd.name: EU R&D expenditure (GERD)
esabcc-f-gerd.description: ESABCC chapter on innovation. Gross domestic expenditure on research and development as a share of GDP. Lisbon agenda target: 3%.

esabcc-f-climate-patents-share.name: Climate-related share of EU patent filings
esabcc-f-climate-patents-share.overview_series: Share of climate patents across all fillings in the EU
esabcc-f-climate-patents-share.description: ESABCC chapter on innovation. Climate-mitigation patents as a share of all EU patent filings (OECD ENV-Tech taxonomy).

esabcc-f-cleantech-investment.name: Cleantech investment in the EU
esabcc-f-cleantech-investment.description: ESABCC chapter on innovation. Total cleantech investment (public + private) relative to EU GDP.
